pattern.description: Continuation of the filmed support-agent shot: the actor lowers his hand from the headset and looks up as he starts speaking to the caller. Natural performance motion, no designed animation.
pattern.why_premium: Shallow depth of field, a soft foreground blur layer and a consistent graded palette make the human scenario feel cinematic and lead into the named-character dialogue.

build_hint.gsap: Not a designed animation: place the footage clip on the HyperFrames timeline as a video layer; optionally gsap.fromTo(clip, {scale: 1.0}, {scale: 1.02, duration: clipLength, ease: 'none'}) for a slow drift.
build_hint.remotion: Render the footage with <OffthreadVideo> inside a <Sequence>; optional interpolate(frame, [0, durationInFrames], [1, 1.02]) scale drift. No spring.

notes: Live-action footage, same shot s019 as e003. The moving hand exits frame, so no candidate box isolates it at the end frame; the full-frame b01 is used. b02-b06 are small diff fragments of the motion blur/head turn, not distinct elements. Camera verdict none.
